data.title: Square Rush
data.gameplay: Create a fast-paced square-tapping score chase. Players press Play, then tap green targets as they light up randomly, starting at one per second and accelerating to five per second. Green targets award points based on their size: one cell gives 10, four cells give 5, and nine cells give 1. Orange obstacles deduct points by size: one cell deducts 10, four cells deducts 5, and nine cells deducts 2. A single-cell red square can appear at any time and resets the score. The goal is to finish with the highest score; optionally support a second player using blue.

data.title: Pirate Survivor
data.gameplay: Raise the cat-skull flag and take the wheel! In Kitty Pirate Survivor you captain a pirate galleon crewed by cats, and the sea is crawling with dog pirates who want your ship at the bottom of it. Drag anywhere to steer. Your cannons fire on their own, so all you have to do is sail smart: weave between enemy ships, dodge their broadsides and keep your hull in one piece. Every wave you survive makes you stronger. Grab treasure to grow your ship's power, then pick a blessing to shape your run: Broadside Brew for more damage, Lucky Rum for more critical hits, Iron Ale for a tougher hull, and more. No two runs play quite the same. Beat four waves to clear the level. The last one brings a boss, a heavily armed flagship that will test everything you've built. Your score counts every enemy you sink, every wave you beat and a big bonus for a full clear. Play again and climb higher. - One-thumb controls, built for your phone - Fast runs you can finish in a few minutes - Auto-firing cannons, so it's all about steering and choices - Blessings that change how every run plays - A boss fight to finish the level Pirate Survivor is a free action game made by @LuckyEcho on Remix. So far Pirate Survivor has racked up 23 plays, 12 players, 2 likes. Play Pirate Survivor in your browser with no game download required. Explore more games by this creator or make your own on Remix.

data.title: Heist Crews
data.gameplay: A co-op comedy heist game for 1 to 4 friends, and the fun comes from planning a perfect robbery and then watching it fall apart. Each player has a role that the others need. BYTE hacks the doors, HAWK spots the guards, MOOSE carries the loot (and throws his friends), and SPARKS cuts the power. No one can pull off the job alone, so you’re always calling out to each other: “Wait! Gary’s turning around! Get in the box!” Every heist starts quiet and tense. You sneak past guards, crawl under lasers and hide in lockers or cardboard boxes. Then one mistake sets off the alarm and it turns into chaos. Cops pour in, robbers tackle guards and drag cuffed teammates to safety, and someone runs for the van carrying a bag bigger than they are. The jobs get stranger as you go. You steal a 900-year-old cheese at a black-tie gala, dodge a spitting llama in a casino, rob the police station run by your teammate’s uncle, and leap onto a speeding gold truck on the highway. The client behind it all only talks through a rubber duck. Runs are short (3 to 5 minutes), easy to pick up and different every time. Random twists like low gravity and bonus goals keep replays fresh, and you get stars, upgrades and plenty of reasons to say “one more try”. Heist Crews is a free action game made by @cryptomantis on Remix. So far Heist Crews has racked up 216 plays, 122 players, 9 likes. Play Heist Crews in your browser with no game download required. Explore more games by this creator or make your own on Remix.

data.title: The Castle Ate Naomi
data.gameplay: Create a retro CRT-style, text-and-audio choose-your-own-path horror-comedy mystery set in a haunted castle. Claire, a sharp-witted Black woman; Larry, a Mexican man with gallows humor; and Steve, a ginger man with terrible timing, search for their missing friend Naomi while deciding whether to split up or stay together. Their choices shape interwoven character paths, who is together, what they discover, and multiple possible outcomes. They investigate strange clues and events—such as a noise in a dark room or a suspicious staircase—to choose where to go and what to believe. The castle is owned by Neklokvekrah, a cruel, powerful wizard-vampire who actively obstructs them. Keep the mood genuinely scary, grotesque, and morbid with sharp situational comedy and simple old-school illustrated CRT visuals. Build a cohesive branching story with reusable paths that can circle back, meaningful choices on every story page, and seeded variations that remain consistent with the mystery. Wrong choices can cause injury, backtracking, or death; make the missing-friend mystery solvable and outcomes reachable through the characters’ available choices.

data.gameplay_zh: 制作一款以闹鬼城堡为背景、采用复古 CRT 风格的文字与音频自选路线恐怖喜剧悬疑游戏。机智敏锐的黑人女性 Claire、善于苦中作乐的墨西哥男性 Larry，以及总是挑错时机的红发男性 Steve，一边寻找失踪的朋友 Naomi，一边决定分头行动还是待在一起。他们的选择将塑造相互交织的角色路线，决定谁与谁同行、他们会发现什么，以及多种可能的结局。他们调查奇怪的线索与事件——例如黑暗房间里的声响或可疑的楼梯——以此选择去哪里、相信什么。城堡的主人是 Neklokvekrah，一个残酷而强大的巫师吸血鬼，他会主动阻挠众人。保持真正恐怖、怪诞且阴森的氛围，融入犀利的情境喜剧，并采用简洁的老派插画式 CRT 视觉效果。构建连贯的分支故事，让路线可以复用并回环，在每一页故事中提供有意义的选择，并加入由种子决定、且与谜团保持一致的变化。错误选择可能导致受伤、折返或死亡；要确保角色能够通过现有的选择解开朋友失踪的谜团，并抵达各个结局。

data.title: Paradise Plunge
data.gameplay: TROPICAL WATERS presents PARADISE PLUNGE — a high-speed 3D water-ride racing game built around momentum, Flow, carving and risk. Launch from the summit of a tropical mountain and race an extreme nighttime water attraction all the way to the resort below. Steer your inflatable tube through steep drops, banked S-curves, glowing glass tunnels, waterfalls, violent currents, wall rides, split routes and dangerous gaps. Follow Fast Flow to build speed, carve high along the walls, skim the lip for risky crests, surf powerful water surges and choose faster expert lines when you’re willing to risk a wipeout. Controls are intentionally simple: A/D or Left/Right = steer Space = hop The challenge comes from learning the ride. Carry too much speed into the wrong line and Paradise Plunge can throw you completely out. Race solo for the fastest time and highest score or challenge up to 8 players in multiplayer. Different tube colors keep racers readable as everyone fights for the fastest Flow lines and best routes. Your final run is scored through speed, Flow, crests, airtime, clean riding, skilled chains and precision at the splashdown. Stay in the ride. Find the Flow. Conquer Paradise Plunge. Paradise Plunge is a free adventure game made by @eman26 on Remix. So far Paradise Plunge has racked up 618 plays, 390 players, 19 likes. data.title: Arrows
data.category_basis: 按来源说明关键词推断，需人工确认
data.gameplay: Arrows is a mobile-first 2D puzzle game. The player sees a grid of arrow tiles (up/down/left/right). Tapping an arrow checks the straight path from that arrow to the edge in the tile’s pointing direction. If the entire path contains no other arrows, the arrow flies off the board and is cleared. If any arrow blocks the path, the tap is invalid: the tapped arrow shakes in place and the player loses one heart. With no timer, the challenge is planning: clear every arrow by tapping them in the correct order. Levels are generated offline/at runtime by placing arrows one at a time in random order; when placing a new arrow, only accept a direction whose path to the edge is clear of arrows already placed (ignore empty/unplaced cells). The exact reverse of the placement order is then the guaranteed valid solve sequence for that board.

data.gameplay_zh: 《Arrows》是一款移动优先的2D益智游戏。玩家面对的是由箭头方块（上/下/左/右）组成的网格。点击一个箭头时，会检查从该箭头沿其指向方向到网格边缘的直线路径。如果整条路径上没有其他箭头，该箭头就会飞出棋盘并被消除。如果有任何箭头阻挡了路径，这次点击无效：被点击的箭头会在原地晃动，玩家失去一颗心。游戏没有计时器，挑战在于规划——按正确顺序点击以消除所有箭头。关卡在离线/运行时生成，按随机顺序逐个放置箭头；放置新箭头时，只接受通往边缘的路径上没有已放置箭头的方向（忽略空/未放置的格子）。随后，放置顺序的完全倒序即为该棋盘保证有效的通关序列。

data.category_basis: 按来源说明关键词推断，需人工确认
data.gameplay: Power of Roberto-P est une aventure semi-3D (caméra arènes) centrée sur un mélange de combats et d’énigmes, où Roberto-P (avec ta photo mise en avant dès le début) guide le joueur à travers 6 parties de plus en plus intenses. Les premières parties mettent en avant des affrontements contre des animaux sauvages avec des pouvoirs magiques et une épée, puis l’apprentissage évolue vers karaté/kung-fu, avant une incursion urbaine et des ennemis stratégiques. La partie 4 introduit des puzzles plus complexes pour débloquer la suite, puis les parties 5 et 6 renforcent la maîtrise (dont de la magie d’énergie à distance) et mènent à un affrontement final épique. Le gameplay principal reste “combat + énigmes”, avec un système de contrôles adapté : PC (clavier/souris) et mobile (boutons à l’écran), incluant un style judo défensif (déséquilibre + contre) en plus des techniques de combat. Le jeu affiche un support global multilingue (anglais, français, créole, espagnol, portugais) avec des drapeaux et une traduction des textes clés. Un système de coins monétise la reprise : si le joueur échoue dans une des parties 1 à 5, il peut acheter des coins pour recommencer la partie échouée (ou rejouer depuis le même point de progression concerné) sans repartir de zéro ; prix : $1.99. Le ton est captivant, “puissant”, fait pour donner envie de raconter le jeu aux autres.

data.gameplay_zh: 《Power of Roberto-P》是一款半3D冒险游戏（竞技场视角），核心在于战斗与解谜的结合，Roberto-P（从一开始就用你的照片作为亮点展示）引导玩家经历6个越来越激烈的章节。最初的章节以用魔法力量和剑与野生动物对战为主，随后学习内容逐渐过渡到空手道/功夫，接着是城市突袭和策略性敌人。第4章引入更复杂的谜题以解锁后续内容，第5和第6章则强化精通（包括远程能量魔法），并最终导向一场史诗般的最终对决。主要玩法仍是“战斗+解谜”，控制方案适配PC（键鼠）和移动端（屏幕按钮），除战斗技巧外还包含防御柔道风格（失衡+反击）。游戏显示全球多语言支持（英语、法语、克里奥尔语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语），配有国旗和关键文本翻译。一套金币系统用于继续游戏变现：如果玩家在第1到第5章中的某一章失败，可以购买金币来重新开始失败的章节（或从相关进度点重新游玩），无需从零开始；价格为1.99美元。基调引人入胜、“强力”，旨在让人想要向他人讲述这款游戏。

data.title: Erik Saves His Sister
data.gameplay: Create a fully 2D, detailed 8-bit medieval fantasy side-scrolling turn-based RPG, designed as a single handcrafted, roughly 20-minute horizontal journey. Erik, a red-haired tank and party leader, sets out to save his kidnapped sister from the Rotten Hag. His companions are Itek, a green dinosaur-man rogue who is fast but fragile; Beth, a cute blonde cleric who is sweet, capable in battle, and nervous outside it; and Bok, a big, badass chicken warrior who uses ranged destructive magic. Explore one continuous side-scrolling overworld as new places and encounters appear, with scenery reflecting the party’s situation. Fight bandits, raiders, ghouls, goblins, a minotaur, a plant monster, and the final Rotten Hag in speed-based turn-based battles inspired by the basic feel of Darkest Dungeon, but without positional mechanics or stress. Add small training moments, side quests, knickknacks, and short stories along the route. Include optional tavern stops for drinks, rumors, and bard songs; wizards and dragons may be friend or foe. Use mouse clicks and WASD as the only gameplay controls. End with Erik saving his sister.

data.gameplay_zh: 制作一款全二维、细节丰富的 8 位风格中世纪奇幻横向卷轴回合制 RPG，设计成一段全手工打造、时长约 20 分钟的横向旅程。红发坦克兼队长 Erik 踏上旅途，要从 Rotten Hag 手中救回被绑架的妹妹。他的同伴包括：Itek，一名速度快但身板脆弱的绿色恐龙人盗贼；Beth，一位可爱的金发牧师，性格温柔，战斗时得心应手，战斗之外却容易紧张；以及 Bok，一位体型高大、霸气十足的鸡战士，使用远程破坏魔法。在一片连续的横向卷轴大地图中探索，沿途会出现新的地点与遭遇，场景也会反映队伍的处境。在以速度决定行动顺序的回合制战斗中，与强盗、劫掠者、食尸鬼、哥布林、牛头人、植物怪物以及最终的 Rotten Hag 交战。战斗的基本感觉借鉴《Darkest Dungeon》，但不包含站位机制或压力系统。沿途加入简短的训练环节、支线任务、小玩意儿和短篇故事。设置可选的酒馆停靠点，供角色喝酒、打听传闻和聆听吟游诗人的歌曲；巫师与巨龙既可能是朋友，也可能是敌人。游戏操作仅使用鼠标点击和 WASD 键。以 Erik 救出妹妹作为结局。

Pick one of more than twenty houses, each with their own original sci-fi twist

Conquer: build fleets and legions, blockade worlds and storm their defenses. Fight battles yourself with tactical orders, or let them resolve automatically.

Scheme: send agents to assassinate, sabotage and preach. Houses remember every insult, and grudges drive their wars.

Rule a bloodline: your characters age, marry, have children and die. Captured generals swear fealty or face judgment. Disloyal heirs tear realms apart in succession wars.

Wield legends: forge Starblades, raise Great Works, and answer the call of the Reclamations over the galaxy's holy worlds.

data.gameplay_zh:
Starblade 是一款围绕王朝与战争展开的科幻回合制大战略游戏，其机制深受《Medieval II: Total War》启发，并融入了独特的科幻主题。

从二十多个家族中选择其一，每个家族都有各自独创的科幻特色。

征服：组建舰队与军团，封锁星球并强攻其防线。你可以亲自下达战术命令指挥战斗，也可以让战斗自动结算。

谋略：派遣特工执行暗杀、破坏与传教任务。各大家族会记住每一次侮辱，而积怨将驱使他们发动战争。

统御血脉：你的角色会衰老、结婚、生子并死去。被俘的将领要么宣誓效忠，要么接受审判。不忠的继承人会在继承战争中将领土撕裂。

掌握传奇之力：锻造 Starblade，建造宏伟奇观，并响应围绕银河系圣地星球展开的收复行动的号召。

data.gameplay: Create “Taxi Sort: City Rush,” a portrait 2D mobile puzzle game. In each short level, tap taxis in an order that lets unblocked cars exit the crowded parking lot and pick up waiting passengers of the same color. Manage the limited waiting area: too many unmatched taxis there means a loss. Progress through increasingly challenging layouts and more colors, with buses and special vehicles introduced as obstacles or sorting challenges. Make the game fully playable and winnable, with clear taps, blocking rules, passenger matching, win/loss conditions, and a 20–60 second pace. Add satisfying vehicle movement, sounds and particles, coins, vehicle skins, a city progression map, local save, and rewarded-ad placeholders for undo, one extra waiting slot, revive, and double coins.

data.title: Finger Haunt – Haunted Survival FPS
data.gameplay: Checkout time is over. The guests disagree. Finger Haunt is a single-player haunted hotel survival FPS with finger guns, furious ghosts and a very unreasonable checkout policy. Step into an illustrated 3D lobby and survive 20 increasingly crowded waves as the hotel's guests refuse to leave. Aim and fire at expressive enemies, dodge ranged attacks, and watch slimes split into smaller, faster pieces. Dash out of danger and time your cooldown-based jump to escape ground attacks. Choose four keepsakes from a pool of nine, improve your favorite upgrades, and earn separate boss powers as you dismiss the hotel's toughest holdouts. Four distinct boss fights lead to the furious Shrine Eye, the guests' final weapon. Expect falling chandeliers, a restless terrace audience and a comic story ending. Clear the campaign, then choose optional Endless mode if you want the hotel to keep fighting back. Play this browser ghost shooter with mouse and keyboard. Choose Relaxed, Standard or Nightmare difficulty, warm up in Practice, and see how long your build can survive. Cartoon horror, chaotic waves and rude hotel guests turn every checkout into a battle.

data.title: Roll & Reload
data.gameplay: A mostly barebones multiplayer first-person shooter where customizable physics-heavy spheres roll omnidirectionally in an outdoor grassy field arena. Players control rolling movement with WASD (omnidirectional), look freely with the mouse, and fire a visible shotgun-barrel gun with a single shot per reload cycle (1 shot, then 2.2s reload). The UI uses a pixel-style font and includes no audio. The game loop is free-for-all: first to 10 kills wins, with 100 health per player. Visual hit feedback includes light snow particles and screenshake on damage. When a player dies, the screen cuts to black and shows red pixel text: “Terminated by <player name>”, then respawns after a 5-second countdown. Match setup uses a dark green pixel-style main menu with “Online” and “Offline”; Online requires alias input, then create/join lobby using a lobby list plus a 5-digit code. Lobbies support up to 6 total players, filling remaining slots with bots (slower reaction times). If a human joins, a bot is kicked and replaced by the new peer. The arena is enclosed by a large wooden fence, with rocks, trees, and small hills to break line of sight, and a bright blue skybox with sunlight.

data.title: TurboCrib
data.gameplay: Create a Cribbage-style card game with classic scoring combinations and a normal round structure (dealer, 4-card hands, crib, pegging round), but using a deck extended with two joker cards and special card-value rules. Jokers are wild: when used, they take on the value of any other card in the deck, including aces, and aces may be 0, 1, or 11. The ace’s value is chosen by each player at the moment it’s relevant (during pegging when played, or during each player’s individual hand-count when the up-card is shared for hand/crib counting). The game is played with a physical-feeling board for pegging advancement and score counting: there are two alternating scoring markers, gallion (the only marker type that can win) and screw. The scoring marker alternates per scoring event (not per physical marker type), and scoring/advancement uses a dedicated board that ends at 161. If the screw would reach/past the 161 hole first, it stops right before 161 and any unused advancement is carried to the opponent as “booty.” Booty cannot be used to win the game. If a player still reaches the end state with booty having accumulated such that it would matter for victory, the game is automatically extended by 30 points: the new win target is 191, with the same gallion-only win condition. In the extension, booty continues to exist, but it cannot trigger another extension (only one extension total). Jokers add additional tactical control: if a player is dealt a joker (in their hand or in the crib), they may either call out its chosen value normally, or sacrifice the joker at any time to flip the gallion/screw positions of their opponent, to block them from winning—especially near the end.

data.gameplay:
It's your first week on the night shift at Pepper's Pizza Palace. The tickets keep coming: chop, plate, bake, serve, hit your tips goal by 6 AM.

But Pepper, the old mascot bear, has a "free-roaming mode" after midnight.

🍕 Cook — pizza and burgers, Overcooked-style. Don't let anything burn.
📹 Watch — check the security cameras. Play his jingle to lure him back down the hall.
🚪 Hold the door — when the jingle runs out, run. Your food keeps cooking while you hold.

Five nights, each harder than the last: burgers, a faster Pepper, rush hour, and a blackout. Earn ★★★ on every night if you can.

Works on desktop (keyboard or gamepad) and phones (touch).

A fan-made parody, not affiliated with Overcooked or Five Nights at Freddy's.

data.title: Nanobot Infection
data.category_basis: 按来源说明关键词推断，需人工确认
data.gameplay: Create a 2D top-down action survival prototype set inside a living organism. The player controls a tiny futuristic nanobot (top-down view) moving with WASD in a semi-maze-like tissue environment, aiming and shooting with the mouse using a fixed starting weapon attached to the nanobot. The world uses simple placeholder graphics that still read as organic biology: glowing tissue membranes, cells, and blood-vessel-like paths with wall/obstacle collision. The game spawns exactly 80 healthy body cells that randomly spawn in open areas and independently wander while avoiding walls/obstacles; a HUD counter shows “Living Cells: 80” and updates as cells die. At the start, spawn exactly ONE dark alien virus far from the player with “Viruses: 1” in the HUD. Viruses wander, detect healthy cells within a detection radius, move toward them, and when touching infect a cell: the cell dies, the virus disappears, and TWO new viruses spawn from the infected cell, enabling exponential multiplication. Viruses have HP=3; nanobot bullets deal 1 damage per hit and kill viruses when HP reaches zero. The player must hunt and destroy all viruses before they infect every cell. Win condition: when Viruses reaches zero, display “VICTORY - Infection eliminated”. Lose condition: when Living Cells reaches zero, display “GAME OVER - The organism has died”. A camera follows the nanobot. Focus the prototype on playable movement, obstacle collision, aiming/shooting, and the cell/virus behaviors, using placeholder visuals for biology and clear visual distinction between healthy glowing cells and dangerous dark viruses.
data.description_basis: 来源页面公开说明；未实际试玩
data.gameplay_zh: 创作一个设定在活体生物内部的2D俯视动作生存原型。玩家操控一台微型未来纳米机器人（俯视视角），用WASD在半迷宫般的组织环境中移动，用鼠标瞄准和射击，纳米机器人自带一把固定的初始武器。世界使用简单的占位图形，但仍能表现出有机生物特征：发光的组织膜、细胞，以及带有墙体/障碍物碰撞的血管状路径。游戏会恰好生成80个健康体细胞，在空旷区域随机出现并独立游荡，同时避开墙体/障碍物；HUD计数器显示“Living Cells: 80”，并在细胞死亡时更新。开局时，会在远离玩家的位置恰好生成1个黑色外星病毒，HUD显示“Viruses: 1”。病毒会游荡，在探测半径内发现健康细胞后向其移动，接触时感染细胞：细胞死亡，该病毒消失，并从被感染的细胞处生成2个新病毒，从而实现指数级增长。病毒HP为3；纳米机器人的子弹每次命中造成1点伤害，HP归零时病毒死亡。玩家必须在病毒感染所有细胞之前猎杀并消灭全部病毒。胜利条件：当病毒数量归零时，显示“VICTORY - Infection eliminated”。失败条件：当Living Cells归零时，显示“GAME OVER - The organism has died”。镜头跟随纳米机器人。原型重点放在可玩的移动、障碍物碰撞、瞄准/射击以及细胞/病毒行为上，使用表现生物特征的占位视觉，并清晰区分发光的健康细胞与危险的黑色病毒。

data.title: Tiny Fishing
data.gameplay: Tiny Fishing is a cozy, casual click/tap-and-drag fishing game where each trip has a quick cast timing moment, then the line automatically returns while the player drags left/right to keep the hook snagging fish on the way up. Players earn coins from fish based on rarity and depth value, then spend those coins to upgrade gear (greater depth for deeper, rarer fish; stronger rods to catch larger fish without breaking free; and increased line capacity to haul more fish per trip). The core loop is: cast for depth → drag to snag fish as the line reorders to the surface → collect coins → upgrade gear for better catches.

data.title: Sketch Highway
data.gameplay: Sketch Highway is a racing game that's drawn while you play. A giant yellow pencil sketches the road just ahead of your car, and a hungry eraser rubs it out right behind you. You can never stop. Keep driving or get erased. Why it's fun: - Every page is a new world. You race through cities, deserts, volcanoes, moon bases, candy lands, haunted towns, ancient Egypt and more than 30 others, all hand-drawn in ink on cream paper. - It's easy to learn and hard to master. Tap left or right to switch lanes and hold to boost. The traffic gets faster and smarter with every page, but there's always a way through if you're quick. - Risk pays off. Close calls and big ramp jumps fill your ink, and ink powers your nitro. The braver you drive, the faster you go. - There are surprises on the road. Grab a rare paper plane to fold your car into a glider and soar over everything, or catch a heart to win back a life. - Beating your best feels great. When you set a new high score, you get confetti and applause. - Play with friends. Race up to 6 players live with just a room code. Set lives, page limits and elimination rules, or sit back and spectate with cinematic cameras. It runs right in your browser on phone or PC. No download, one more run every time. Sketch Highway is a free action game made by @lookhemu on Remix. So far Sketch Highway has racked up 2.3K plays, 472 players, 74 likes.
